title: Custom Node & Code Panel
description: Inspect the JavaScript behind any node or build your own Custom Nodes with custom ports, roles, and reusable blueprints in the Code Panel.

blocks.content: Every node in Lupis Engine runs JavaScript at runtime. You can open any node in the **Code Panel** to inspect how it works, unlock a built-in node to customize its behavior, or create a [Custom Node](node_library/custom) with your own input and output ports.

items.title: Transparent Code
items.desc: Double-click any node in the graph to view its JavaScript implementation in the **Code Panel**.

items.title: Custom Ports & Roles
items.desc: Choose **Action**, **Event**, or **Pure** roles and add typed input and output pins.

items.title: Live Validation
items.desc: Catch syntax errors, unused ports, and missing variables in real time while you type.

items.title: Reusable Blueprints
items.desc: Click **Save as Blueprint** to add your custom node to the project's **Node Library**.

blocks.content: When you select a **Custom Node** in the graph or edit it in the **Code Panel**, you configure its interface in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) and write its logic using four built-in runtime objects.

rows: Sets the node's header label, accent color, and summary notes.
Switches between **Action (Exec In + Out)**, **Event (Exec Out only)**, and **Pure (Data only)**.
Provides **Save as Blueprint**, **Edit Node Script**, **Revert to Preset** (for unlocked system nodes), and **Delete Node**.
Creates a new custom data port. Click the port name to rename it using alphanumeric characters.
Sets the port **Data Type** (**number**, **string**, or **boolean**), reorders ports with **Move Up** and **Move Down**, or deletes the port.

blocks.content: Inside the **Code Panel**, your script has access to **inputs**, **outputs**, **context**, and **node**. The top status bar validates your code automatically as you type.

rows: Read-only object containing the current values of all input ports on the node.
Writable object for sending values to output ports and advancing execution flow with **outputs.execOut = true**.
Provides safe access to engine domains, variables, assertions, and per-node **context.state**. See [Context System API](visual_scripting/context_system_api).
Every node script must end with an explicit **return;** statement.

blocks.message: Custom port names must use alphanumeric characters only (such as **damageAmount** or **isCritical**) with no spaces, hyphens, or underscores. The **Code Panel** shows a warning if a defined port is never read or assigned in your code.

blocks.content: Follow these steps to create a custom node, configure its ports, and save it as a reusable blueprint.

items: In an open script graph, click **+ Add Custom Node** in the **Node Library** panel (or right-click empty canvas space and select **Add Custom Node**).
In the **Header** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), set the node **Title** and choose its **Role**.
In **Ports Configuration**, click **+ Add Input Port** or **+ Add Output Port**, rename each port, and open the 3-dots menu to set its **Data Type**.
Double-click the node header (or right-click the node and click **Edit Code**) to open the **Code Panel** tab.
Write your JavaScript logic, read every input port via **inputs**, assign every output port via **outputs**, and verify that the top badge shows **No Issues**.
To reuse this node across other scripts in your project, click the 3-dots icon in the **Header** section and select **Save as Blueprint**.

blocks.message: To customize a built-in node, double-click it to open the **Code Panel** and click **Unlock** in the bottom-right status bar. You can restore the original built-in behavior at any time by clicking **Revert to Preset** in the **Header** 3-dots menu.
